The '''Fellowship of Alms''' is one of the guilds which proliferate in [[Altara]] but particularly in the city of [[Ebou Dar]]. 

All beggars in the city are required to maintain membership in the brotherhood and to wear a small brass ring signifying their continued membership and continuity of their dues.{{ref/book|7|29}} They guard thier trade most jealously, often beating or even killing off those not members of the fellowship.
